My dear [Miss Dodgson](/person/2423),

I will keep your card to consider in case a certain poor Alfred Shany is disposed of, he is 43, and every five years has to be freshly voted for as he will be turned out on his family's hands.[^2]

I well remember that day of [your Brother](/person/261)'s photography. [^3] It was the only time except once that [my mother](/person/1606) was photographed so we should be very glad to have the negatives   If the parcel were sent to Miss Bowles at Ranmure [?] there would be sure to be a safe opportunity before long

yours very sincerely

C M Yonge


[^2]: Alfred Shany is unidentified, but was evidently an inmate in an institution whose subscribers voted for candidates.
[^3]: CMY and FMY had been photographed by the Rev. Charles Lutwidge Dodgson in Oxford on 4 May 1866.
